notes: Love-focused relates to attachment and care.
Transparent suggests honesty; machiavellian suggests deceptive or unethical manipulation.
Prudish/flirtatious concerns sexual modesty or restraint.
Innocent relates to purity or being uncorrupted.
Nice can imply kindness; naughty/nice is broad moral evaluation.
Straight edge implies abstinence; junkie relates to bodily contamination/intemperance.
Utopian/dystopian evokes broad ideal versus bad social conditions.
Parental implies nurturance and a parent-child authority role.
